package.description: Mirror an iPhone to Windows over AirPlay with audio, recording, screenshots, and a presentation-ready device frame.

en-US.description: Mirror an iPhone to Windows over AirPlay with audio, recording, screenshots, and a presentation-ready device frame.
en-US.longDescription:
MirrorSim is a free, open-source Windows app that mirrors an iPhone over AirPlay in a clean device frame.
It supports live audio, iPhone volume following, automatic orientation, screenshots, screen recordings, trusted devices, diagnostics, and automatic updates.
en-US.name: MirrorSim
